name: quake-q
description: Replaces the letter "q" in the editor with the Quake 1 icon. Only the q; the rest of the text is unchanged.

quakeQ.enabled.description: Replace the letter q with the Quake 1 icon.

quakeQ.color.description: Top color of the icon gradient (CSS hex).

quakeQ.shadowColor.description: Bottom color of the icon gradient (CSS hex).

quakeQ.iconScale.description: Size of the icon relative to the letter it replaces (q: x-height plus descender, Q: cap height plus descender). It never exceeds the line height.

quakeQ.verticalOffset.description: Vertical adjustment of the icon in pixels (positive = lower), in case it does not line up with your font.

quakeQ.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Optional: name of a Quake font **installed on your system** (e.g. `DpQuake`). When set, that font is used for the q instead of the icon.
